tools.name: get_summaries

tools.description: [content_fetch] Verbatim transcript of ONE recording by conversation_id. Paginated (offset / next_offset) — page through for more.

conversation_id.description: required; opaque id string (may be 19-digit snowflake)

tools.name: get_transcripts

result.description: Tool-specific result payload; shape varies per tool (object for most; may be null/array/text for some). Intentionally type-unconstrained for strict-validating clients.

tools.description: [metadata_query] List recordings by time window / participants. Returns id, title, started_at, ended_at, duration_seconds, participants, language_code (no content). Paginated (count default 100, max 200; offset). order_by ranks within the window. NOTE: `participants` are speaker labels — placeholders ('Speaker A/B') unless the user tagged them, not necessarily real names.

offset.description: page offset; use the response's next_offset

order_by.description: duration_seconds | started_at | action_item_count — server sorts the whole window and returns the top `count`.

participant_names.description: Exact participant filter (may return 0 for un-tagged/anonymized people).

tools.name: list_conversations

result.description: Tool-specific result payload; shape varies per tool (object for most; may be null/array/text for some). Intentionally type-unconstrained for strict-validating clients.

tools.description: [search] Unified recording search. Runs bounded searches over transcript lines, topic segments, memory atoms, participant metadata, titles, briefs, summaries, and action items in one call. Returns typed hits plus conversation_ids, line_ids, segment_ids, memory_atom_ids, participant_ids, brief_ids, summary_ids, action_item_ids. Chat execution expands hits into readable evidence automatically; external callers can fetch returned ids where a matching fetcher is advertised.

conversation_ids.description: Optional: restrict to these opaque recording ids.

query.description: Required. One phrase for a single concept, or a JSON array string of 2-4 distinct facets.

search_types.description: Optional lane filter. Omit to search all. Allowed: transcript, segment, memory_atom, participant, title, brief, summary, action_item.

tools.name: search_recordings

result.description: Tool-specific result payload; shape varies per tool (object for most; may be null/array/text for some). Intentionally type-unconstrained for strict-validating clients.

tools.description: [metadata_query] Conversation-level metadata for the given conversation_ids: id, title, started_at, ended_at, duration_seconds, participants, language_code. No transcript, brief, or summary body.
tools.name: get_conversations

result.description: Tool-specific result payload; shape varies per tool (object for most; may be null/array/text for some). Intentionally type-unconstrained for strict-validating clients.
